description: Reviews VaultSync commands that prune snapshot history, restore backup data, unregister projects, or repoint project roots while keeping inspection-oriented commands outside the extension review boundary.
name: VaultSync command protection
saferAlternatives: Use list-projects, history, diff, and verify to inspect backup state before making changes.
Use prune --dry-run before approving snapshot deletion.
Use restore --dry-run before approving restore writes or cleanup.
